name: flow
description: Ambient scenes above the prompt that move with your agent's work: a fire, bubbles, surf, ski, rockets, a hot-air balloon and more, by day or night. /flow to control it.

mode.title: Scene mode
mode.description: auto moves with Claude's work; manual holds the level below

style.title: Scene
style.description: fire: a ░▒▓█ fire with sparks and smoke; warp: stars that speed up to hyperspace; avalon: a colony ship whose shield burns up the asteroids that hit it; balloon: a hot-air balloon that climbs from the grass to space; engine: a steampunk engine that runs up to full speed; falcon: a Falcon 9 carrying Dragon: its booster lands on its legs, Dragon comes home under parachutes to a splashdown; starship: a bigger rocket that hot-stages: its booster is caught by the tower's arms, the Ship splashes down; surf: a surfer and the swell; ski: a skier down the mountain; bubbles: bubbles fizzing up; train: a train through the countryside, faster with the work

idle.title: Scene while idle
idle.description: Auto mode while Claude is idle: a low glow, or dark (the band gives its rows back)

layout.title: Scene layout
layout.description: band: a strip above the prompt; spine: a tall pane docked beside the transcript (fullscreen)

level.title: Manual level
level.description: Manual mode's level: 0 (off) to 10 (the busiest the scene gets)

time.title: Day or night
time.description: For balloon, falcon, starship, surf, ski, bubbles and train: clock follows your local time (night from 19:00 to 7:00); day or night pins it

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: A soundscape for each scene that swells with the work: crackling fire, surf, chuffing steam, rocket roar (macOS only; off by default)

volume.title: Sound volume
volume.description: How loud the soundscape plays: 1 (quietest) to 10; 7, the default, is as it was tuned, each step below it 3 dB quieter. Above 7 the quieter sounds come up most: the loudest already play near full
